`2021 – 2024`

**Topics:** thermal power · LNG · environmental, social & health impact assessment

**My contributions:** environmental baseline, impact assessment chapters, fieldwork supervision

**Skills used:** IFC Performance Standards, ADB Safeguard Policies, environmental monitoring, GIS

## Overview

Gas-fired and LNG-to-power plants are being developed in Vietnam to meet rising electricity demand. These large projects require Environmental, Social and Health Impact Assessments (ESHIA) that meet international lender standards.

## Projects

- **Son My 2**: 3 × 750 MW gas-fired thermal power plant, Binh Thuan Province (AES Corporation)
- **Bac Lieu LNG-to-Power**: 3,200 MW project, Bac Lieu Province (Delta Offshore Energy)

## My role

- Supervised environmental fieldwork across water, soil, air, noise and biodiversity
- Authored the **Environmental Baseline** chapter: climate, hydrology and topography
- Authored impact chapters on surface water, groundwater, air, noise and soil, aligned with IFC Performance Standards and ADB Safeguard Policies
